description: AAASM-5353 negative: ordinary Traditional-Chinese prose carrying the numeric content real documents carry - dates, versions, ports, counts and monetary amounts - must produce no locale findings. This is the defect the Epic exists to fix, approached from the other side: AAASM-5344 took 32 KB of clean zh-TW prose from 87 findings to zero, and recognizers loose enough to flag ordinary numbers would be the same defect with a different cause. Numerically dense on purpose: a pure-Han corpus would pass even if every recognizer matched any digit run.
